GetMysqlSlowLogTemplate.fingerprintMd5: MD5 value of the normalized SQL fingerprint

Supported fields: executeTimes: number of executions; durationSum: total execution time; durationMax: maximum execution time; durationMin: minimum execution time; durationAvg: average execution time; lockTimeSum: total lock time; lockTimeMax: maximum lock time; lockTimeMin: minimum lock time; lockTimeAvg: average lock time; scanRowsSum: total scanned rows; scanRowsMax: maximum scanned rows; scanRowsMin: minimum scanned rows; scanRowsAvg: average scanned rows; returnRowsSum: total returned rows; returnRowsMax: maximum returned rows; returnRowsMin: minimum returned rows; returnRowsAvg: average returned rows
GetMysqlSlowLogTemplate.order: Sort order. Ascending: asc; descending: desc
